title: The Guardian da ke gefen Kogin
intro: A ƙasar da dokar azzalumi ta kawo baƙin ciki ga gidaje da yawa, rai ya sami saƙo wanda ke ƙin dukkan tsoro. Da zuciya cike da aminci, suka fara aikin imani wanda zai canza al'umma. Yayin da ruwa ke ɗauke da kaya mai tamani, bege ya haɗu da raƙuman ruwa.
clues: Na rayu a lokacin zalunci da tsoro.
Na sami wahayi daga Allah wanda ya ba ni ƙarfin hali.
An umarce ni da kada in ji tsoro ko in yi baƙin ciki.
Na sanya ɗana a cikin akwati na ajiye shi a kan ruwa.
Gidan mai mulkin ne ya sami ɗana, amma ɗayan yarona ya biyo baya.
Na sake haɗuwa da ɗana domin in shayar da shi nono, kamar yadda Allah ya yi alkawari.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Yin wahayi zuwa ga jefa yaro cikin kogi
trial.answer: Yin wahayi zuwa ga jefa yaro cikin kogi

options: Akwati da aka sanya a cikin kogin

location.answer: Akwati da aka sanya a cikin kogin

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An mayar da yaron lafiya ga ma'aikacin jinya
An kai yaron zuwa wata ƙasa mai nisa
Yaron ya zama mai mulki nan da nan
Wani attajiri ɗan kasuwa ne ya ɗauki yaron
outcome.answer: An mayar da yaron lafiya ga ma'aikacin jinya

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
